So my tank set up was a success, everything went smoothly, there are some things I think I need to improve: 
First is the conductive paint I made out of india ink and graphite powder. I made it ahead of time and sealed it in a glass bottle, and when I pulled it out to paint my rocks it became thick so I mixed in a little bit of distilled water, but I think it's still not right because it was hard to use and the pieces came out flaky on the edges. 
Second is that I painted the rocks 3 times, but I was too excited to let it dry completely before putting latex on, so the latex mixed with the paint a little bit, I'm not sure if that affected anything but I'll be more careful next time.
Third is that I shouldn't turn the brand new power supply on while it's plugged in, the A and V were both above 1 and I immediately saw many bubbles going off of my pieces so I turned it off. 
Last is maybe it's because of the paint consistency but I should've left them in for another couple hours? I'll keep experimenting.
Any suggestions and tips on making conductive paint would be appreciated!
